design_philosophy: E1 Tactical Elite. A mobile-first inventory management tool for a Brazilian retail store counter. High tension, absolute clarity, bold 'Electric Blue on Obsidian Black' theme. The UI must feel like a precision command center, not a generic SaaS app.

font_pairings.headings: Outfit, sans-serif (Strong, technical, squarish for high data legibility)
font_pairings.body: Manrope, sans-serif (Clean, geometric, readable at small sizes)

rules: NEVER use generic fonts like Inter or Roboto for headings.
Always left-align data and text. Centered text is forbidden except in empty states.
Prices (R$) must be highly legible and use the 'price' class styling.

layouts.mobile_first_strategy: The 'Command Center' layout. Designed for one-handed operation on a store counter.
layouts.spacing: Generous. Use p-6 and p-8 for containers. The gap between components should be gap-6 or gap-8.
layouts.navigation: Sticky bottom navigation bar with Glassmorphism (backdrop-blur-xl bg-background/80 border-t border-white/10). No hidden hamburger menus.
layouts.dashboard_grid: Dense but clear. Product cards stacked vertically (grid-cols-1). Each card is a wide horizontal layout: Photo on left (w-24 h-24), data and buttons on right.
layouts.surface_strategy: Grid Borders (The 'Technical' Look). Use flat backgrounds with 1px border-white/10. No heavy shadows in dark mode.

visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid hsl(215, 28%, 17%) for all cards and inputs to define boundaries.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Use for sticky headers/footers: backdrop-blur-xl bg-background/70 border-b (or border-t) border-white/10.
visual_enhancers.badges: Stock status badges must be small, high-contrast pills with text matching the status color (e.g., text-emerald-400 bg-emerald-400/10).

product_card.style: Flat, horizontal card layout. border border-border bg-card rounded-md p-4.
product_card.image: Rounded-md, w-24 h-24 object-cover on the left.
product_card.content: Right side contains Product Name, Price (R$), and Stock status badge.
product_card.actions: Massive +1 (Entry) and -1 (Sale) buttons on the bottom right of the card. -1 should be primary colored, +1 should be secondary/outline.

buttons.primary: bg-primary text-white font-bold rounded-md px-6 py-4 (Huge tap targets).
buttons.whatsapp: bg-[#25D366] text-white font-bold rounded-md. Use only for 'Send Full Report' and 'Request Restock'.

inputs.style: bg-background border border-border text-foreground p-4 rounded-md focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary focus:border-transparent.

rules: Use specific transitions: transition: transform 0.2s ease, opacity 0.2s ease, background-color 0.2s ease.
Buttons: Active state must scale down slightly (active:scale-95).
Hover states: Lighter background color, never rely on inheritance.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure APCA contrast standards. Dark mode text must be bright enough (foreground is 91% lightness).
accessibility.touch_targets: Minimum 48x48px for all interactive elements (buttons, inputs).
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid="sale-button-productId").

instructions_to_main_agent: You are building a mobile-first web app using React (.js, not .tsx) and Tailwind.
Implement the dark theme by default by hardcoding the CSS variables in index.css as provided in this guide's colors, or forcing the 'dark' class on the HTML tag.
Use Shadcn components but heavily customize them. Strip away the generic 'Vercel-look'. Make buttons chunky and borders sharp (rounded-md max).
Do NOT use HTML <select> or <input type='date'>. Use Shadcn DropdownMenu and Calendar.
Integrate Lucide React for icons. Use precise, technical icons (e.g., Database, Zap, Plus, Minus, MessageCircle for WhatsApp).
Use 'sonner' for toast notifications (e.g., 'Stock updated', 'Report sent').
Ensure the Store Config screen exists to set the owner's WhatsApp number.
Ensure 'Request Restock' directly formats a WhatsApp URL (e.g., https://wa.me/...) with the product details.
Do NOT use transparent backgrounds for the sticky headers. Use backdrop-blur-xl with bg-background/80.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Do not use generic centered layouts or simplistic gradients.
Create depth through layered design elements and 1px borders, even in dark mode.
You MUST NOT apply universal transitions (transition: all).
You MUST NOT center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; } is forbidden).
Always use modern button styles (chunky, distinct active/hover states).
Never use AI assistant emojis. Use lucide-react icons.
All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes.
